minutes.headline: Committee reworked its draft town meeting slides comparing renovation and rebuild; only minutes were voted.
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Design Committee mostly reviewed a draft slide presentation on the tear-down and new-build option for town meeting. Members agreed to add background slides on the renovation, standardize naming, split the floor-plan slides, add a square footage comparison slide and end with both prices. Prior minutes were approved and the meeting adjourned by roll call.

what_happened.line: The committee spent most of the meeting editing a draft town meeting slide deck comparing a tear-down and new build with the renovation option.
Members agreed to split the floor-plan slides so none shows two building sections, and to add a key map showing where each plan sits.
Members agreed to add a single slide comparing the square footage of renovation and new build.
The final slides will show the new-build total, then both prices side by side.
The only vote was approval of prior minutes; the meeting then adjourned by roll call.

why_it_matters: The slides are what voters will see at town meeting, and the committee chose to end on both prices side by side, so the comparison residents vote on will be framed in dollars.
A finance committee letter in the warrant addresses the cost of borrowing for this project, which bears on what the debt would add to tax bills.
